status: PROPOSED — the media buyer never calls Pages and Pages never calls the media buyer. This contract says what Pages must carry so the OMS can hand the media buyer an `ad_id`. The source of truth is Pages (it answers); when adopted there, this file becomes a verbatim copy.
direction: PUSH through the OMS door: Pages → OMS `/api/v1/landing/orders` (+ abandoned carts). Pages holds its own OMS key (system = landing, scopes products.read + orders.create). Nothing flows to the media buyer directly.

auth.rule: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, exactly like the media buyer's own /mcp connector (reference implementation, public: src/core/oauth.ts + src/server/oauth.ts in the media buyer repo). The system that OWNS the data is the authorization server; the owner presses «اربط ← اسمح» once; nobody copies a token. The Bearer header on each call is unchanged.
auth.authorization_server: OMS (the data owner) — Pages is the client of the OMS here, not of the media buyer

endpoints.authorize: GET /oauth/authorize (the owner is logged in to that system and approves)
endpoints.token: POST /oauth/token (authorization_code + code_verifier S256, refresh_token with rotation)

auth.lifetimes: access token about one hour; refresh token about 60 days, rotated on every use; a revoked client or grant is refused on the very next call
auth.refused: a redirect address that was not registered, a missing or wrong PKCE verifier, a code used twice
auth.status: ADD — on the authorization server's side (small if it copies the reference implementation; additive; the old per-system keys can keep working until the owner switches)
auth.note: Pages gets its OMS token by «اربط ← اسمح» in the OMS, like the media buyer; no OMS_LANDING_TOKEN is pasted. The existing landing key keeps working until then.

rate_limit: 600 per minute on the landing key (existing)
idempotency: `Idempotency-Key` header on every order write (existing, required by the OMS door): one key is one order.

join.summary: ad link → Pages (reads the tags) → order body → OMS stores → /orders/attribution → media buyer joins on ad_id

worked_example.source: spend: OMS GET /api/v1/ad-spend row for that ad and day (the OMS pulled it from Meta); orders: OMS GET /api/v1/orders/attribution rows with the same ad_id — both from the OMS, joined by ad_id
worked_example.rule: orders_in = all rows; confirmed = status in confirmed, shipped, delivered, returned; delivered = status delivered; cost = spend / count

join.note: The media buyer's launch builder already writes these url_tags on every ad it creates (src/core/templates.ts URL_TAGS). Ads created before it have none: those orders keep the `naming` method (product level, an estimate) and never pose as real per-ad numbers.

endpoints.path: every landing page, on the first view
endpoints.change: Read the seven query parameters above once, keep them for the whole visit (first-party cookie or session, 7 days, first touch wins unless a newer paid click arrives), and keep them through the AI assistant «سارة» chat, the checkout and the abandoned-cart recovery link (a recovered cart must still carry the ad it came from). Digits-only ids: anything that is not 6–25 digits is dropped, not stored.
endpoints.size: small — a read of the query string and one stored object

endpoints.change: Send the stored tags in the existing body's optional `attribution` object. Everything else in the body is unchanged (and keeps going to the OMS only: Pages' customer fields never go to a model or to the media buyer).

errors.when: an id that is not digits, or an unknown field

endpoints.size: small — an optional object; the OMS accepts the order with or without it (ADD oms.landing-attribution-intake)

endpoints.change: The same optional `attribution` object on a cart, so a cart that is recovered and ordered keeps its ad.

never: no customer name, phone or address in `attribution`
no tag value is ever sent to a model
no ad-account token is ever on a landing page

pages.note: the token is obtained by «اربط ← اسمح» and stored encrypted by Pages

env.note: Nothing is required on the media buyer's side for this link.

$comment: Written by the media buyer (docs/INTEGRATION_CONTRACTS.md). A published version never breaks: only optional fields are added; a removed, renamed or retyped field is v2. No customer name, phone or address in any field, under any name.
